notes.title: Big Update - version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10021896/f7e43d3ac58bdc7c800971610195b96d36c8d431.png[/img]
- New feature: Checkpoint in most Mines and Factory levels
- New feature: Summary screens with basic statistics
- New feature: Best time for each level is saved locally
- New feature: 3 keyboard control presets
- Change: All Buzzsaws has now same size
- Change: Rocket smoke trail doesn't kill anymore
- Change: Buzzsaws can't go over teleports
- Change: Fly now is now slower and rotates toward direction before rushing (so you can see where it'll go)
- Bugfix: teleportation animation
